annotations.title: How to add a connector to Grok Bot

description: Explains how an app gets into Grok Bot: built-in plugins (Connect apps in the sidebar), custom MCP servers (you ask the Bot in chat to add a URL; must be public HTTPS using streamable HTTP or SSE), and the browser-only route when neither exists. Includes this server's own URL as a worked example. Takes no input and reads nothing from the database.
name: how_to_add_connector
title: How to add a connector to Grok Bot
